items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 October 2026 5:43am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 23 October 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales.


##Synopsis##

Deep low in the English Channel will continue tracking eastwards today, new Atlantic low will become a very deep feature tomorrow.


##Wind##

North or Northeast 5 to 7, backing Northwest 7 or gale 8 through this morning. Little change in afternoon, decreasing West or Northwest 6 or 7 in evening, then backing and decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, soon building moderate or rough, falling moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Heavy rain at first, gradually turning lighter and clearing eastwards today.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor at first, improving good today.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, backing and increasing South 7 to severe gale 9 through tomorrow morning, then veering West or Southwest gale 8 or severe gale 9 later in day.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building rough or very rough.


##Weather##

Fair, then heavy rain for a time, clearing later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
